description.value:
You've learned to bend an opponent's will with ease. Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

A number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, when you make an attack roll using Wisdom you may add half your Charisma modifier to it; alternatively, when making an attack roll using Charisma, you may add half your Wisdom modifier instead. This pool of uses refreshes after a long rest.

Separately, a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, you may treat an effect you control that calls for a Wisdom saving throw as calling for a Charisma saving throw instead, or one that calls for a Charisma saving throw as calling for a Wisdom saving throw instead. This pool of uses also refreshes after a long rest.
